title: Talking About Hobbies
subtitle: Getting to know someone new — for English learners

sentences.en: So, what do you usually do in your free time?
sentences.target: So, what do you usually do in your free time?

sentences.en: I really enjoy hiking and taking photos when I'm out in nature.
sentences.target: I really enjoy hiking and taking photos when I'm out in nature.

sentences.en: That sounds fun. How long have you been into photography?
sentences.target: That sounds fun. How long have you been into photography?

sentences.en: About three years now. I started with my phone and slowly upgraded my gear.
sentences.target: About three years now. I started with my phone and slowly upgraded my gear.

sentences.en: Do you ever sell your photos or just keep them for yourself?
sentences.target: Do you ever sell your photos or just keep them for yourself?

sentences.en: Mostly I post them online, but I've sold a few prints to friends.
sentences.target: Mostly I post them online, but I've sold a few prints to friends.

sentences.en: What about you — do you have any hobbies?
sentences.target: What about you — do you have any hobbies?

sentences.en: I play guitar in a small band, and we practice every weekend.
sentences.target: I play guitar in a small band, and we practice every weekend.

sentences.en: That's awesome. Do you write your own songs or play covers?
sentences.target: That's awesome. Do you write your own songs or play covers?

sentences.en: A bit of both, honestly. We're working on our first original album right now.
sentences.target: A bit of both, honestly. We're working on our first original album right now.

sentences.en: I'd love to hear it when it's ready. Let me know!
sentences.target: I'd love to hear it when it's ready. Let me know!
